empty.title: Download your country's map
empty.body: You're seeing a basic world map, with no streets. Download your country to get streets, routes and emergency points offline.
empty.downloadingBody: When it's done you'll have its streets, routes and emergency points here, offline. You can keep using the app meanwhile.
empty.stoppedBody: What's already downloaded is kept: a retry picks up where it left off.

location.deniedBody: Allow location access in Settings to see where you are on the map. It works offline using GPS.
location.unavailable: Couldn't get your location. Try again outdoors.

regions.title: Your maps
regions.intro: Each country comes with its map at full detail, offline navigation and its emergency points.
regions.worldBody: Only countries, big cities and main roads, no streets. Comes with the app.
regions.deleteBody: This frees {{size}}. You can download it again any time.
regions.updateBody: A newer version of the map is available ({{size}}). Download it while you're online.

download.notEnough: Not enough space: you need {{needed}} and have {{free}} free.
download.offline: You need an internet connection to download maps. They work offline afterwards.

points.title: Points on the map
points.showBody: Hospitals, water, shelters and more from your downloaded maps. They appear as you zoom in.

kinds.health: Hospitals, health centers, pharmacies, defibrillators and ambulances
kinds.security: Police, fire stations and military sites
kinds.water: Drinking water, springs, shelters and assembly points
kinds.supplies: Supermarkets, hardware shops and fuel stations

points.footer: Tap a point to see what it is, call it or go there. The full list, sorted by distance, is under SOS.

markers.title: Saved places
markers.emptyBody: Long-press anywhere on the map to drop a pin.
markers.name: Name

search.hint: Towns, streets and places in your downloaded maps. Coordinates too: decimal, degrees or UTM.
search.noMaps: Download a map to search offline. Meanwhile you can paste coordinates.

call.failedBody: If this device can’t make calls, dial {{number}} from another phone.
call.invalid: “{{number}}” doesn’t look like a phone number.

guidance.straightLine: As the crow flies: it doesn’t follow roads or paths
guidance.arrivedEnds: Guidance will end on its own in a minute.
guidance.noCompass: No compass: the arrow points relative to map north
guidance.deniedBody: Guidance needs your location. It works offline thanks to GPS.

emergency.title: Emergency
emergency.numberInAmbulance: {{country}} has no single emergency number: this is the ambulance's.
emergency.numberInPolice: {{country}} has no single emergency number: this is the police's.
emergency.fromMapCenter: No location: distances from the map center
emergency.empty: No places of this kind in your downloaded regions.
emergency.noDataBody: Your maps' emergency points will download on their own as soon as you're online.
emergency.noRegions: Download your country's map: it brings its hospitals, pharmacies, drinking water and shelters.
emergency.offline: You need an internet connection to download emergency places.
emergency.source: OpenStreetMap data. It may be incomplete or out of date: in an emergency, call {{number}}.
emergency.preparingBody: Downloading the hospitals, pharmacies, drinking water and shelters of your maps…

route.noPack: Download routing for this area to follow roads and paths.

error.noRoad: There is no road or path near the start or the destination.
error.noPath: No way between the two points with this mode.
error.tooFar: Too far for this mode of transport.
error.unavailable: Routing is not available in this build.

route.lastStretch: The route ends here: follow the arrow to the destination.

country.mapReduced: Streets and roads. It's a very large country: a little less detail so it fits on a phone.
country.routingBody: Routes by car, on foot and by bike, with turn-by-turn directions.
country.routingMissing: Not available in this country yet: you'll be guided in a straight line to your destination.
country.pointsBody: Hospitals, pharmacies, police, drinking water and shelters, and every street in search.
country.wifiHint: Best on Wi‑Fi with the phone charging. You can keep using the app meanwhile.
country.routingUnknown: Couldn't check while offline. Try again once you're online.
country.regionsBody: Each region brings its map, its navigation and its emergency points. Download yours and add others any time.
country.regionsBodyShared: Each region brings its map at full detail. Navigation, search and emergency points for all of {{name}} ({{size}}) come with the first region, so routes from one region to another work.
country.regionsBodySharedIn: Each region brings its map at full detail. Navigation, search and emergency points for all of {{name}} are already on the phone.
country.crossRegions: Routes from one region to another go in a straight line.

us-northeast.states: New York, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Vermont, New Hampshire and Maine

us-south.name: South
us-south.states: Texas, Florida, Georgia, the Carolinas, Virginia, Tennessee, Alabama, Louisiana, Kentucky, Maryland, Washington, D.C. and more

ca-atlantic.name: Atlantic
ca-atlantic.states: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island and Newfoundland and Labrador

ru-central.name: Central
ru-central.states: Moscow, Voronezh, Yaroslavl, Tula, Ryazan and Smolensk

ru-northwest.name: Northwest
ru-northwest.states: Saint Petersburg, Kaliningrad, Murmansk, Arkhangelsk and Karelia

ru-south.name: South
ru-south.states: Rostov-on-Don, Krasnodar, Sochi, Volgograd, Astrakhan and the North Caucasus

ru-volga.name: Volga
ru-volga.states: Nizhny Novgorod, Kazan, Samara, Ufa, Perm and Saratov

ru-siberia.name: Siberia
ru-siberia.states: Novosibirsk, Omsk, Krasnoyarsk, Irkutsk and Barnaul

ru-far-east.name: Far East
ru-far-east.states: Vladivostok, Khabarovsk, Yakutsk, Kamchatka and Sakhalin

carplay.savedEmpty: Save places on the phone's map to have them here.
carplay.searchEmpty: No results in your downloaded maps.
carplay.straightLine: As the crow flies: it doesn't follow roads
carplay.noPermission: Allow location access on the phone to navigate.
